source.title: On Two-Sided Estimates for the Nonlinear Fourier Transform of KdV
source.author: Jan-Cornelius Molnar

common_conventions.potential: Real-valued, mean-zero, period-one functions on T=R/Z. The same physical KdV Birkhoff map Omega is used in all statements.
common_conventions.coordinate_indices: n >= 1, with two real coordinates x_n,y_n; no n=0 action or signed duplicate
common_conventions.topologies: Sobolev and weighted Hilbert norm topologies; weighted actions use the indicated l1 norm. Bi-analyticity means real analytic maps with real analytic inverse in these norm topologies.
common_conventions.poisson: Gardner bracket integral (d_u F)*partial_x(d_u G); {x_n,y_m}=delta_nm, {x_n,x_m}={y_n,y_m}=0. This sign must not be inherited from the accepted NLS convention.
common_conventions.hill: L(q)=-d^2/dx^2+q on [0,2] with periodic boundary conditions, q period one. Fourier basis exp(i*pi*k*x); free spectral value pi^2*k^2. Formula (2), page 5, fixes the second derivative; the page-8 display has an omitted exponent.
common_conventions.spectral_labels: Source: lambda_0^+, then pairs lambda_n^-,lambda_n^+ for n>=1 (complex labels are lexicographic). For real period-one L2 potentials the intrinsic labels now satisfy lambda_0^+=label(0)<lambda_1^-=label(1)<=lambda_1^+=label(2)<lambda_2^-<=..., exhaust the physical characteristic roots and retain their analytic orders. They are continuous in the inherited L2 norm topology and independent of auxiliary cutoffs/weights. Delta(lambda_0^+)=2 and Delta(lambda_n^±)=2*(-1)^n. The lowest characteristic root is simple; an open gap has two simple endpoints and a closed gap has one double endpoint. The abstract operator algebraic-multiplicity comparison is not asserted.
common_conventions.contour_action: I_n=(1/pi) integral_Gamma_n lambda*Delta'(lambda)/sqrt_c(Delta(lambda)^2-4) d_lambda, with the branch/circuit conventions on pages 9-10. Higher actions J_(n,m) have lambda^(m+1)/((m+1)*pi).

main_statements.label: Theorem 1
main_statements.quantifier_order: Fix the same Omega; for every integer m>=1, there exist c_m>0,d_m>0, independent of u, such that for every u in H_0^m both estimates hold.
main_statements.adapter_constants: An action-bound constant C or D gives coordinate-bound constant 2*C or 2*D. These adapters require the physical identities and action bounds explicitly; they do not prove those hypotheses.
main_statements.remaining: The full actual weighted Cartesian Hilbert sequence has complex analytic extensions at every real native source. Physical moment gradients and zero mutual Gardner brackets, complete labelled Dirichlet poles and residue contraction, genuine mean-zero isospectral sources, stationary implicit normalized differential germs and exact physical base values are checked. Every positive Dirichlet label now has a genuine analytic branch whose derivative along every physical moment source equals the sheet root times the residue, including zero sheet factors. On the regular terminal locus the contracted actual branch variations converge to the signed Kronecker period. Still required: identify this terminal contraction with the derivative of the actual full Abelian phase, including endpoint and collapsed Cartesian charts; establish normalized action/phase and Cartesian Gardner brackets, a global inverse on the mean-zero real space, and fixed physical KdV Birkhoff identification. Main Theorems 1 and 3(i) remain unverified; Theorem 2 and Theorem 3(ii) remain verified.

main_statements.label: Theorem 2
main_statements.quantifier_order: For every integer m>=1, there exist c_m>0,d_m>0 before quantifying every u in H_0^m.
main_statements.remaining: No proof obligations remain for Theorem 2 under the source’s defining Arnold contour action formula. The physical Birkhoff map is a separate dependency of the coordinate theorems.
main_statements.inverse_spectral_native_status: Verified as the inverse inequality of Theorem 2.
main_statements.paired_spectral_native_status: Verified as Theorem 2 via exact source Arnold normalization and physical/Fourier Sobolev correspondence.
main_statements.physical_spectral_status: Verified: both inequalities hold for the exact normalized source Arnold contour actions, with the exact physical/Fourier Sobolev norms. The source explicitly defines I_n by this contour formula, so constructing the coordinate map is not a dependency of this action theorem.

completion_audit.source_definition: arXiv:1502.04550v1, Section 2, printed pages 8–9: the nth KdV action variable is explicitly defined as (1/pi) times the contour of energy*Delta_prime/canonical_root around the nth gap. The normalization uses -2*i*sqrt(energy-lambda0)*product standardRoot/(k^2*pi^2).
completion_audit.domain: RealHillWeightedPotential (hillIntegerWeight m) with coefficient zero at 0 is the full real mean-zero period-one Fourier H^m domain. hillIntegerWeight_apply and hillPeriodOne_sobolev_norm_sq give the exact (1+|2*pi*k|)^(2m) norm. The native/scalar inclusion maps are coefficient-preserving inverses; the physical realization and arbitrary continuous representative are identified by Fourier uniqueness.
completion_audit.quantifiers: theorem2_arnold and theorem2_continuous place c_m,d_m>0 after m>=1 and before all potentials; there is no potential-dependent constant or supplied spectral package.
completion_audit.normalization: sourceArnoldAction is the source contour formula with the actual energy canonical-root product; sourceArnoldAction_eq_gapIntegral and sourceArnoldActionMass_eq_native identify the actual actions and their exact positive-index (2*pi*n)^(2j+1) sums.
completion_audit.inequalities: Both displayed inequalities, all exponents and the lower norm/order m-1 agree with the source. The forward and inverse results are proved from the physical hierarchy and global action-moment comparisons.
completion_audit.axioms_and_validation: The declarations and all their dependencies are covered by the current strict focused build and transitive axiom audit; source and validation-input hashes are recorded in verification.json. No coordinate-map existence or unproved action identity is assumed.
completion_audit.scope: This verification applies to Theorem 2 as the source action theorem defined by its contour formula. It does not assert that a physical Birkhoff coordinate map has been constructed.

main_statements.label: Theorem 3
main_statements.domain: w_n=(1+|n|)^r*v_n, 0<=r<=1/2, v in M; H_0^w and h_*^w with weights w_(2*n), not w_n.
main_statements.weight_class: M: w_n>=1, w_(-n)=w_n, w_(n+k)<=w_n*w_k, and w_|n|<=w_(|n|+1). Piecewise linear interpolation to R is used in evaluating the bound.
main_statements.quantifier_order: For each admissible w,r there exists c_(w,r)>0 independent of u, then for every u in H_0^w, Omega(u) belongs to h_*^w and both estimates hold.
main_statements.remaining: The full actual weighted Cartesian Hilbert sequence has complex analytic extensions at every real native source. Physical moment gradients and zero mutual Gardner brackets, complete labelled Dirichlet poles and residue contraction, genuine mean-zero isospectral sources, stationary implicit normalized differential germs and exact physical base values are checked. Every positive Dirichlet label now has a genuine analytic branch whose derivative along every physical moment source equals the sheet root times the residue, including zero sheet factors. On the regular terminal locus the contracted actual branch variations converge to the signed Kronecker period. Still required: identify this terminal contraction with the derivative of the actual full Abelian phase, including endpoint and collapsed Cartesian charts; establish normalized action/phase and Cartesian Gardner brackets, a global inverse on the mean-zero real space, and fixed physical KdV Birkhoff identification. Main Theorems 1 and 3(i) remain unverified; Theorem 2 and Theorem 3(ii) remain verified.

action_part_completion_audit.domain_and_weight: The exact source class w(n)=(1+|n|)^r*v(n), 0<=r<=1/2, v in M is constructed as SpectralWeight.product (sobolev r) v. RealHillWeightedPotential w with coefficient 0 at index 0 is the real mean-zero Fourier H^w domain.
action_part_completion_audit.quantifier_order: A positive constant c is chosen after r and v, before every potential; the final conclusion contains no supplied spectral family, cutoff parameter, additional regularity, or unproved coordinate/action hypothesis.
action_part_completion_audit.normalization_and_topology: The norm is the weighted Fourier l2 norm with w(2k); the real piecewise-linear weight extension is evaluated at exactly 16*||q||_w^(3/2-r). The action is the verified actual source Arnold contour with the energy canonical-root product. The full positive-index action series is summable.
action_part_completion_audit.constant_correction: The checked gap-tail remainder is 2304 rather than 576. This is absorbed in a valid larger c; the explicit weight argument and all powers remain unchanged.
action_part_completion_audit.scope: This verifies Theorem 3(ii), which is an action statement. Theorem 3(i) and the main theorem as a whole remain unverified until the physical Birkhoff-coordinate map is constructed.

associated_corollaries.label: Corollary 1 (first occurrence)
associated_corollaries.scope: For integer m>=1, a global KdV solution with u(0)=u0 in H_0^m satisfies ||u(t)||_m<=alpha_m*(||u0||_m+(1+||u0||_(m-1))^(m^2+m-1)*||u0||_(m-1)) for every real t; alpha_m independent of u0,t.

associated_corollaries.label: Corollary 1 (second occurrence)
associated_corollaries.scope: For every real s>=0, exists c_s uniform in u in H_0^s: S_s<=c_s*(1+A_s)^max(1,s)*A_s and Q_(2*s+1)<=c_s^2*(1+A_s)^(2*max(1,s))*A_s^2, including the mapping property into h_*^s.

new_proved_foundation.source_correspondence: The free Fourier denominator and complementary inverse used in the proof of Lemma A.3, page 27, after the P_n/Q_n splitting on page 26. This is not Lemma A.3's full convolution estimate ||V*A_lambda^-1*Q_n||<=2*||q||_w/n.
new_proved_foundation.strip: For n>=1: |Re(lambda)-pi^2*n^2|<=6*n. This explicit narrower strip replaces the printed radius 12*n for this candidate; no downstream localization constants are yet claimed.
new_proved_foundation.domains_and_topologies: Complex Coeff p and WeightedCoeff w p, with 1<=p<=infinity and their Banach norms; arbitrary positive weight w. The reciprocal multiplier is zero when |k|=n and inverse(lambda-pi^2*k^2) otherwise.
new_proved_foundation.proved_bounds: |n^2-k^2|<=||lambda-pi^2*k^2|| for |k|!=n, and operator application norms <=(1/n)*||a|| for both unweighted and weighted spaces. The pointwise right inverse is the projection deleting the two resonant modes; uniqueness includes that deletion explicitly.
new_proved_foundation.not_claimed: No construction of perturbed Hill spectrum, periodic differential operator domain, discriminant, contour action, canonical coordinates or Birkhoff map. No result for the printed wider strips follows merely by renaming this strip.
